output.numbers: one (scalar) or two (shape=(batch_size,)) when both 'a' and 'b' are 1-d vectors; three (shape=(batch_size, input_size, output_size)) otherwise
output.description: ------- ndarray The matrix product of the inputs. This is a scalar only when both ``x1``, ``x2`` are 1-d vectors.

constraints: If the last dimension of 'a' is not the same size as the second-to-last dimension of 'b', an error will be raised.
When both 'a' and 'b' are 1-d vectors, vector, vector returns the scalar inner product.
